data.narrative:
Comand AI, a seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Loïc Mougeolle and Antoine Chassan, has raised €11.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—spanning seed and Series A stages within the same sector.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the €11.5M raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying a valuation of $29M. Peer-median analysis examines four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE ($1.0B seed), Stark Defence ($4.0B Series A), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A). The median across this peer set is $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis produces a low estimate of $24M, a median of $364M, and a high of $805M. The extreme divergence between the stage-progression method and peer-median reflects material stage and traction gaps relative to the peer set, particularly UFORCE. Key uncertainties include Comand AI's product maturity relative to Series A peers, customer validation, and defensibility within a crowded defense-tech landscape. The wide range indicates that near-term milestones will be critical to resolving valuation dispersion.
